name: BIOL 1109
title: Topics in Modern Biology
description: Readings, lectures, seminars, films and field trips exploring current developments in biology and their social and scientific implications. May be repeated with a change of content. May be repeated for credit.
requirement_description: Concurrent enrollment in BIOL 1107 or 1108 required. Students cannot earn more than 12 credits of 1000 level BIOL.
